intent: Repair the source-confirmed capability response contract: feature flags must be JSON booleans, descriptive icon and numeric disconnect-grace metadata belong in typed fields, and Android compatibility must be tested against complete actual-route fixtures.
ownership: Complete sanitized actual-route capability fixtures shared with Android tests
Server-side schema and fixture drift behavior regressions
constraints: Android production changes are owned by diagnostic_execution.
Root owns gateway package manifest, architecture index, release integration and remote writes.
Keep package validation, authorization, model identity and inference verification unchanged.
Fixtures contain deterministic local test state only, never private configuration or diagnostic logs.

confirmed_defect.source: gateway/gateway_v13.py gateway_capabilities, inherited by the v14/v15 composition root
confirmed_defect.baseline_regression: The strict-boolean feature test failed on all six actual Uvicorn HTTP route aliases before the runtime edit.
confirmed_defect.historical_scope: This is a reproduced source/response contract defect. It does not establish which field caused any private historical decode failure when the response body and decoder exception were not captured.

implementation: Remove icon and disconnect-grace metadata from features; retain all actual feature booleans.
Reuse the existing ui_contract.gateway_tool_icon string and expose numeric singleflight.disconnect_grace_seconds.
Capture complete pre-fix and corrected responses through a real locally launched Uvicorn gateway with intact package validation, middleware and startup lifecycle.
Keep canonical fixtures inside the gateway package and identical Android test-resource copies; enforce both route equality and copy equality.

normalization: build.sourceCommit replaced with forty zeroes after validating its shape
instanceId replaced with thirty-two zeroes after validating its shape

validation.package_validation: Root authorized a temporary generated source manifest for actual-route validation. It is restored before commit; integration owns final manifest regeneration.
limits: Android decoding/negotiation tests are owned by diagnostic_execution and are not included in these server counts.
No private deployment repair, Android device, external provider or hardware execution is asserted.
